verdict.rationale: The README states that Zero "does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way," and the product documents self-hosting, which together suggest there is no usage tracking to opt out of. This rests on a single first-party assertion, with no documented telemetry settings or verification. Missing for 10: documented telemetry/analytics configuration or opt-out controls, disclosure of any third-party analytics in the hosted version, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-tracking claim.
